scientific_limitations: The homotopy and full automorphism homology-action result is specific to the fourteen-vertex Fano-plane incidence graph. No larger-plane classification, equivariant homotopy equivalence, or independently verified publication priority is asserted.
title: The Heawood dominance complex is a six-sphere with orientation-preserving incidence symmetries
